verdicts.why: The girl is unnamed in episode 1; she gives the alias Rachel in episode 2 and reveals her real name, Amy, only in episode 4, so naming her in the S2#1 entry is a spoiler.
Episode 2: the religious man visits Beth in the Michigan hospital and threatens her family and friends until she reveals the name Pete; the night with Frank and the bar shooting are episode 1.

The LF1 crash site is the fictional Hutan Simpanan Borneo (Borneo Forest Reserve) near Sibu, Sarawak (fandom: about 20 miles west of Sibu); only Wikipedia's uncited plot says Miri, and the New Straits Times review of the scene names the reserve near Sibu.
In episode 3 (No Good Deed) the FBI houses Fisk in the penthouse of the Presidential Hotel; episode 2 is the convoy attack and episode 4 is Dex's review and Matt's prison break-in.
Dex, dressed as Daredevil, kills Lantom at Clinton Church in episode 10 (Karen); episode 11 opens with Nadeem taking over the crime scene.
Strange is critically injured in the fight with the zealots at the New York Sanctum and teleports to the hospital, where Palmer saves him; he is not stabbed in astral form.
At the Roosevelt Island facility Jean creates a psionic field, and Parker lets her enter his mind, where she sees a memory of May; he does not enter hers.

The episode 1 flashbacks (Ronin's massacre of the Tracksuits and Maya's fight with Daredevil) are dated 2021 by the wiki, which matches the entry's own text, so the sub takes the year.

Same Manhattan office scene as lead 6 (one event, one entry); the warehouse raid happens outside the city.

Peggy stops the gas attack and Fennhoff is caught at Howard Stark's warehouse and private airfield, which the screen places outside the city ('They're trying to leave the city'), while Stark is turned back before he reaches New York.
Fennhoff hypnotizes Stark at his secret warehouse outside the city; Times Square is only the target, and Stark never reaches it.
Sousa captures Fennhoff at the warehouse outside the city, and the cell beside Zola is at a prison the episode does not name.

Howard's name is cleared at a press conference at New York City Hall in Manhattan, with Jarvis beside him, until Dottie's rigged rifle opens fire and a hypnotized officer drives off with Stark, leaving Jarvis behind. So the clearing happens here, and the in-flight part is only the end of the episode.
value: At a press conference at City Hall, the SSR clears Howard Stark's name, until shots ring out and a hypnotized police officer drives off with him, leaving Jarvis behind.

verdicts.why: Hypnotized by Ivchenko and strapped into the Stark heat vest, Dooley jumps from a window of the SSR's New York Bell Company office as it explodes.
At the Griffith Hotel in Manhattan, Peggy hides on a window ledge and gets away from the raid with Angie's help, then Dottie knocks her out and Thompson and Sousa arrest her.
Sousa reveals Peggy to Dooley and the SSR hunts her down at the Griffith; this is the same event as lead 27, so it gets one entry.
Dottie knocks Peggy out at the Griffith before Thompson and Sousa arrive; this is the same event as lead 27, so it gets one entry.

While Krzeminski drives the captured guard back to SSR headquarters, an unidentified assassin rams the car at a traffic light and shoots them both. The episode does not name the killer, so naming Dottie would be a spoiler.
Simpson kills Clemons where he guards the evidence and sets the place on fire; the episode's location is the Decommissioned CDC Facility in Brooklyn, not Hell's Kitchen.
Jessica brings Ruben's head to the 15th Precinct, and Kilgrave takes control of everyone in the station while Clemons and Mahoney are dealing with her.
Trish arrives to see Jessica in the middle of a break-up with Oscar, who has met someone else; the episode is set at Jessica's apartment and Alias Investigations.
Trish helps Jessica hunt Sallinger's next victim, and Sallinger murders Dorothy at Dorothy Walker's Apartment in Manhattan, where Trish finds her.
Same episode 8 event as lead 15 (Dorothy's murder at her Manhattan apartment), so it gets one entry.

In episode 10, Wilson attacks Ori's hotel fundraiser in an explosive belt and takes Karen hostage, Frank frees her and lets Wilson blow himself up, and Mahoney questions the survivors. Karen publishes the letter in episode 9.
Same hotel attack as lead 4, so it gets one entry; Wilson dies in his own blast there.
Mahoney investigates and questions the survivors, including Russo, Ori, Madani and Page; this is the same event as lead 4, so it gets one entry.
At the New York Bulletin Building in Manhattan, Ellison says they must wait and contact the FBI before printing the manifesto, and later turns on the news showing that Castle is alive.
Madani meets James in New York City (the episode's locations are in Manhattan), and James tells her to stay out of it and let Castle and Russo kill each other.
Karen confronts Manning, who threatens her with what he knows about her family; the episode's locations are in Manhattan.
Karen visits Ellison at Riverbank Medical Center in Manhattan after the Bulletin attack, and he orders her to reveal Daredevil's identity or quit.
Dex, dressed as Daredevil, attacks the New York Bulletin Building in Manhattan, fights Matt and kills Evans before he can testify; this is the same event as lead 36.
